note: A frozen set of LinearRAG reproduction conditions for the 재현 점검 benchmark (tests/eval/audit_bench.py). Each is a condition a code base can follow or break; statements and quotes come from a real `spec` run (2026-10-13), quotes verbatim from the paper. Not included: what code cannot show (dataset sizes, GPU), what the benchmark folder never implements (baseline runs). The method conditions (category method, 2026-10-13 spec run with the usage prompt) carry `base`: their status in repro_base, which follows every value but only sketches the method (judged by reading its code; ambiguous = not scored).

conditions.statement: 주요 실험은 HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, MuSiQue, Medical의 네 데이터셋을 사용한다.
conditions.quote: including HotpotQA (Yang et al., 2018), 2WikiMulti- HopQA (2Wiki) (Ho et al., 2020), MuSiQue (Trivedi et al., 2022), and the Medical dataset

conditions.statement: 각 검증 세트에서 1,000개의 질문을 선택한다.
conditions.quote: choosing 1,000 questions from each validation set.

conditions.statement: 각 패시지는 구두점(마침표, 느낌표 등)을 기준으로 문장으로 분할한다.
conditions.quote: we first segment each passage into sentences using punctuation (e.g., periods or exclamation marks)

conditions.statement: 개체명 인식에는 spaCy를 사용한다.
conditions.quote: We then apply lightweight models (e.g., spaCy (Honnibal et al., 2020)) for named entity recognition (NER)

conditions.statement: 그래프는 엔티티, 문장, 패시지의 세 종류 노드로 구성된다.
conditions.quote: It constructs a graph that contains three types of nodes: entity nodes, sentence nodes, and passage nodes.

conditions.statement: 패시지 검색 단계는 활성화된 엔티티를 시드로 한 Personalized PageRank를 사용한다.
conditions.quote: apply personalized PageRank on the entity–passage subgraph, exploiting the activated entities in the first stage as seeds

conditions.statement: Personalized PageRank의 감쇠 계수는 0.85이다.
conditions.quote: is the damping factor (typically 0.85)

conditions.statement: 동적 가지치기 임계값 δ는 4로 설정한다.
conditions.quote: And, we setδ= 4based on our experimental setting.

conditions.statement: 패시지 초기 점수의 절충 계수 λ는 0.05로 설정한다.
conditions.quote: optimal performance is achieved whenλtakes a relatively small value (e.g., 0.05)

conditions.statement: 모든 방법의 top-k 검색값은 5이다.
conditions.quote: We setk= 5 for topkretrieval in all meth- ods.

conditions.statement: 모든 방법은 all-mpnet-base-v2 임베딩 모델을 사용한다.
conditions.quote: all algorithms use the same embedding model,i.e., all-mpnet-base-v2

conditions.statement: 생성과 평가에는 GPT-4o-mini를 사용한다.
conditions.quote: All RAG approaches employ the same LLM (GPT-4o-mini) for both generation and evaluation tasks.

conditions.statement: 정답이 생성 답변에 들어 있는지를 Contain-Match Accuracy로 평가한다.
conditions.quote: Contain-Match Accuracy (Contain-Acc.), which checks if the correct answer appears in the generated response

conditions.statement: 예측 답이 정답과 맞는지를 GPT-Evaluation Accuracy로 평가한다.
conditions.quote: GPT-Evaluation Accuracy (GPT-ACC.), an LLM-based metric that assesses whether the pre- dicted answer matches the ground truth.

conditions.statement: Medical 데이터셋은 GPT-ACC만으로 평가한다.
conditions.quote: For the Medical dataset, since golden answers consist of lengthy descriptive statements, we only evaluate using GPT-ACC.

conditions.statement: LinearRAG는 2Wiki에서 GPT 기반 정확도 63.70%를 달성한다.
conditions.quote: LinearRAG achieves 63.70% GPT-based accuracy on 2Wiki

conditions.statement: LinearRAG는 2Wiki에서 Contain 기반 정확도 70.20%를 달성한다.
conditions.quote: boosts Contain-based accuracy to 70.20%.

conditions.statement: Tri-Graph는 entity, sentence, passage 노드와 entity-문장 및 entity-passage 연결로 구성된다.
conditions.quote: We construct a hierarchical graph, called Tri-graph, with multiple granularities that is efficient to maintain and update.

conditions.statement: 질문에서 추출한 각 entity는 그래프에서 가장 유사한 entity에 초기 활성화된다.
conditions.quote: Then for each extracted entity, we find the most similar entity in the knowl- edge graph.

conditions.statement: 문장-entity 그래프에서 질문-문장 유사도를 이용해 중간 entity의 활성화 점수를 전파한다.
conditions.quote: Semantic propagationthat propagates the similarities inσ q through semantic similarity extrac- tion to activate relevant intermediate entities

conditions.statement: 각 전파 단계에서 관련성 점수가 임계값을 넘는 새 entity만 다음 반복에 유지한다.
conditions.quote: A newly activated entity is retained for the next iteration only if its relevance score exceedsδ; otherwise, it is pruned.

conditions.statement: 활성화된 entity를 seed로 사용해 entity-passage 그래프에서 Personalized PageRank로 passage 중요도를 집계한다.
conditions.quote: The second stage performs global impor- tance aggregation with hybrid initialization for passage nodes to retrieve important passages using Personalized PageRank

conditions.statement: 최종 검색 결과는 passage의 PageRank 점수가 높은 top-k passage이다.
conditions.quote: Passages are ranked by their PPR scoresI(v|v∈V p), and the top-kpassages with the highest scores are selected for retrieval.

open.statement: 실험에 쓴 난수 시드가 논문에 없다.
생성 단계에서 사용할 구체적인 프롬프트 템플릿은 명시되지 않았다.
